mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates economic weakness and potential corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals successful monetary policy easing that reduces inflation expectations and lowers discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL decrease by at least 0.1% in the prior month over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST) signal sustained consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST is above its 50th percentile in late-cycle expansion regimes over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity and corporate output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is above its 50th percentile over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment level (PAYEMS) above 135,000 thousand persons indicates a strong labor market and robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS > 135000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% indicates persistent inflation and potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 50th percentiles over any 3-year rolling window.
